actions.reason: C0001 has coherent biological support (strong RNA metabolic/EMT signature with corroborating CNV CDKN2A/9q loss and 20p/20q gain), no set-level technical confounder, and positive though small cross-modal boundary separation from all other sets. Structural probes show no reproducible internal subdivision or insufficient separation. Residual uncertainty from weak silhouettes and directional-only WXS is not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has coherent biological support (moderate RNA pathway signal with a distinct CNV depletion pattern contrasting with C0001) and positive cross-modal boundary separation from all other sets, with no reproducible internal subdivision or insufficient separation. A significant tissue-source-site (BP) enrichment is a concerning competing explanation for part of the signal, but it does not negate the defensible discovery-stage candidate; this limitation is carried as uncertainty for downstream validation.

C0003 has strong coherent biological support (BAP1 enrichment at q=4.8e-06 with an interferon/inflammatory transcriptional profile), the highest resampling stability (ARI 0.764), and positive cross-modal boundary separation from all other sets without reproducible internal subdivision or insufficient separation. A significant tissue-source-site (BP depletion) association is a concerning competing explanation for part of the signal, but the candidate remains defensible at discovery stage with this limitation carried forward.

C0004 has coherent biological support (strong WXS PBRM1/VHL depletion with significant q-values and a directionally coherent transcriptional pattern), no set-level technical confounder, and positive boundary separation from all other sets including strong WXS separation. Structural probes show no reproducible internal subdivision or insufficient separation. Low multi-modal membership support and non-significant RNA/CNV are limitations carried as uncertainty, not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.
